europe_now.summary: Finland has summoned the Russian ambassador following a suspected helicopter incursion and airspace violation. The diplomatic move highlights ongoing security tensions along the border.

top_stories.title: New EU Sanctions Push
top_stories.summary: The European Union is preparing a new round of sanctions aimed at Russian ex-soldiers, banks, and sports. Measures under discussion include bans on Russian flags and teams at European sporting events.

top_stories.title: Emissions Trading Policy Debate
top_stories.summary: Eight European Union member states have formally rejected any further delays to including transport and heating in emissions trading. The debate underscores ongoing divisions over the implementation speed of green policies.
